## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npm run type-check` exits 0
- [ ] New or changed behavior has tests; mocks mirror the real Devvit API
- [ ] No secrets, real usernames, or real comment text in code, tests, or screenshots
- [ ] New Redis keys have a TTL and are listed in `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`
- [ ] New settings are validated and listed in the README settings table
- [ ] Docs updated (README / ARCHITECTURE / BACKLOG / story status)
- [ ] Playtested on a test subreddit (say what you tried), or N/A
